codeReview.summary: The commit does introduce shared CSS custom properties for transitions, shadows, and common radius values in `base.css`, and the touched sidepanel files compile against those tokens. However, the implementation only consolidates a small subset of the repeated patterns in the targeted styling area, leaving many of the same `999px`/`9999px` radii and spring/fast transition literals unchanged in the same files and adjacent sidepanel CSS modules, so the feature does not fully satisfy the contract's stated consolidation scope or the claimed ~10KB-savings intent.

issues.description: The feature specifically targets consolidating repeated transition patterns into custom properties, but `composer.css` still contains multiple untouched `transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);` declarations at lines 882, 1220, 1263, and 1287 after the refactor. Leaving the same repeated spring transition literal in the same stylesheet shows the consolidation is incomplete for one of the explicitly targeted pattern classes.

The feature also targets common repeated values, but `panels.css` still retains numerous repeated pill/full radius literals (`border-radius: 999px;` at lines 144, 153, 202, 303, 316, 511, 1162, 1180, 1193, 1952 and `border-radius: 9999px;` at 527, 538, 1706, 1716, 1784, 1797) plus unchanged fast transitions at lines 831, 1267, 1304, and 2018. Since the new `--radius-pill`, `--radius-full`, and `--transition-fast` tokens exist but were not applied across these repeated occurrences, the contract's common-value consolidation is only partially implemented.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission/contract says the CSS consolidation feature should deliver about 10KB of savings, but there is no documented baseline/measurement procedure for CSS bundle-size deltas in the shared mission guidance, so the worker validated by manual review without any reproducible size comparison for this target.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `validation-contract.md` defines `VAL-BUNDLE-004: Build Size Reduced` only as a generic 'dist/ folder smaller than baseline', and the handoff for `consolidate-css-patterns` records no baseline-vs-after CSS size measurement beyond `git diff --stat` and build success.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The refactor-worker skill does not tell workers how to judge completion for style-only deduplication tasks with quantitative savings goals, so the worker stopped after introducing a few tokens even though many identical literals remained in the same targeted CSS surface.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `.factory/skills/refactor-worker/SKILL.md` focuses on validators and file size, while the reviewed commit leaves repeated spring transitions in `composer.css` and repeated pill/full radii and fast transitions in `panels.css` despite the feature description explicitly targeting transitions, shadows, and common values.

summary: Fail. The change adds useful shared CSS tokens, but consolidation is incomplete: repeated transition and radius literals remain throughout the targeted sidepanel styles, so the feature does not fully meet the CSS-pattern consolidation contract.
